title: Greengage and Discover the World collaborate to bring ECOsmart Certification to the Australian market
summary: Greengage Solutions has announced a new collaboration with Discover the World to expand its ECOsmart sustainability certification programme into the Australian accommodation, travel, meetings and events market. title: New UK research reveals face-to-face is vital in AI-enabled world
summary: AI is increasing the need for human meetings, not reducing it, according to new research commissioned by The Meetings Show.
